questions.q: Which purchase order type is used for a one-time purchase where the item, estimated cost, quantity, and delivery schedule are all already known?
options: Blanket purchase agreement
Contract purchase agreement
Standard purchase order
Requisition template
questions.explain: A standard purchase order fits a fully defined, one-time need - exactly Dana's 50-unit bearing order.

questions.q: What is distinctive about a blanket purchase agreement compared to a standard purchase order?
options: It requires no approval of any kind
It can never be used with a preferred supplier
It is only used for services, never goods
It locks in negotiated pricing with a supplier without necessarily knowing the delivery schedule or total quantity up front, and is fulfilled later through releases
questions.explain: A BPA negotiates pricing ahead of time; actual deliveries are fulfilled later through releases issued against it as needs arise.

questions.q: What does a contract purchase agreement (CPA) typically cover?
options: A longer-term legal agreement with a supplier, often covering terms and conditions, with or without specific items or prices
Only purchases under $100
Only purchases requiring four-way matching
A one-time emergency purchase order
questions.explain: A CPA is a longer-term legal agreement, which can set terms and conditions that standard purchase orders may reference, independent of specific items or prices.

questions.q: Why does Dana's requisition for 50 bearings become a standard purchase order rather than a blanket release?
options: Because standard purchase orders are always required for MRO items
Because this specific need is a fully defined, one-time order with a known item, quantity, price, and delivery date
Because Meridian Bearing Supply Co. does not support blanket agreements
Because Dana is not authorized to use agreements
questions.explain: The one-time, fully defined nature of this specific order matches the standard purchase order profile rather than requiring an agreement release.

questions.q: Which two document types are both categorized as "supplier agreements" (long-term arrangements)?
options: Blanket purchase agreement and contract purchase agreement
Standard purchase order and requisition
Receipt and invoice
Change order and close order
questions.explain: Blanket purchase agreements and contract purchase agreements are both classified as supplier agreements, distinct from the one-time standard purchase order.
